rubrics.evidence: The patch reintroduces a single per-quality descriptor throughout the pipeline. In parsePlaylist.ts, getSourceQualities replaces getPlayUrls/getSourceWidths/getSourceHeights/getSourceBitrates and returns SourceQuality[] via qualities.map((quality) => ({quality, ...sourceMap[quality]})), building one complete descriptor per quality. types.ts defines SourceQuality extends PlaySource with quality: Quality, so the descriptor carries the full playlist-entry field list. VideoSourceContext.ts collapses the five parallel arrays (sourceQualities/playUrls/sourceWidths/sourceHeights/sourceBitrates) into a single sourceQualities: SourceQuality[]. VideoSourceProvider.tsx, Video.tsx, NormalVideo.tsx, and the hls/mp4 VideoComponent.tsx all pass and consume sourceQualities: SourceQuality[] instead of parallel member arrays, reading fields like match?.play_url from the matched descriptor. getMasterM3U8Blob.ts now takes sources: AdaptiveSource[] and destructures {play_url, bitrate, width, height} per descriptor rather than indexing into separate arrays.
rubrics.criterion: Per-quality playback data (media address, quality, dimensions, bitrate and the other attributes a playlist entry carries) is produced, distributed and consumed as one descriptor per quality throughout the pipeline: playlist parsing builds complete descriptors, and the player-core data path passes those descriptors instead of parallel member arrays.

rubrics.evidence: The agent replaces index-based parallel-array resolution with quality-keyed lookups on grouped descriptors. In VideoSourceProvider, currentSrc resolves via `sourceQualities.find((source) => source.quality === currentQuality)` with the existing first-entry fallback `(match ?? sourceQualities[0]).play_url`. In the HLS VideoComponent, quality switching uses `sourceQualities.find((source) => source.quality === currentQuality)` and `match?.play_url`, feeding it into both the synthesized-auto path (`levels.findIndex((l) => l.url.includes(playUrl))` / `hls.nextLevel`) and the normal path (`hls.loadSource(playUrl)`); when the synthesized 'auto' is selected it is absent from sourceQualities so the find returns undefined and the reload block is skipped, preserving the already-loaded adaptive blob behavior. getMasterM3U8Blob now takes a grouped `AdaptiveSource[]` and destructures `{play_url, bitrate, width, height}` by field name rather than indexing across `playUrls`/`sourceBitrates`/`sourceWidths`/`sourceHeights`. The native/MP4 path consumes `currentSrc` from context (which carries the fallback). No `indexOf` + parallel-array indexing remains in any resolution or switching path.
rubrics.criterion: Current-address resolution and quality switching read the descriptor by quality (with the existing fallback to the first entry), preserving which media loads for the selected quality in the native, MP4/MSE and HLS paths, including when the synthesized auto quality is selected.

rubrics.evidence: The agent's patch rewrites getMasterM3U8Blob to accept a single grouped array (AdaptiveSource[] with play_url, bitrate, width, height) and derives bandwidth, resolution, and address from each descriptor entry via destructuring: `sources.map(({play_url, bitrate, width, height}) => ({source: play_url, bandwidth: bitrate! * 1024, resolution: {width: width!, height: height!}}))`. The old flat defaulted parameter list (`playUrls: string[], sourceBitrates: number[] = [], sourceWidths: number[] = [], sourceHeights: number[] = []`) with internal index zipping is removed. The HLS VideoComponent calls `getMasterM3U8Blob(sourceQualities)` passing the grouped SourceQuality[] directly with no re-encoding into separate parallel arrays and no positional ordering dependencies.
rubrics.criterion: The HLS adaptive master-playlist synthesis derives bandwidth, resolution and address from each descriptor entry, with no caller re-encoding the columns (no positional ordering dependencies and no defaulted empty columns) between the HLS component and the synthesis utility.
